subject: website
name: Nanjing Massacre digital memorial
summary: A Chinese-language memorial site with a timeline and archive links. No public source was found. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Bilibili video players, whose scripts, API calls and chat sockets come from Bilibili hosts, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: Bilibili players (player.bilibili.com, hdslb.com, bilivideo.com)
connections.note: Embedded players loaded when the page opens, with scripts, API calls and websockets.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
